svg.aria-label: From a pixel to a ray: the pixel becomes NDC from -1 to 1, with y = -1 at the top. With depth 1 and w = 1, inverse(projection × view) takes it back to the far point scaled by 1/w; dividing by w gives a world point on the far plane, and the ray runs from the camera towards it.
svg.title: From a pixel to a ray: the pixel becomes NDC from -1 to 1, with y = -1 at the top. With depth 1 and w = 1, inverse(projection × view) takes it back to the far point scaled by 1/w; dividing by w gives a world point on the far plane, and the ray runs from the camera towards it.
